name: Isozaki Ryousuke
source:
The protagonist's childhood friend and ex-boyfriend.
After he graduated from an athletic academy he became a professional basketball player. 
However right now he is recovering from an injury so he is acting as a special coach for the Futaba Academy's basketball club.
